content: MCP Python SDK v2.0.0 released: speaks 2026-07-28 + 2025-11-25 (2025-06-18 not documented in v2); FastMCP renamed MCPServer (mcp.server.mcpserver.*), types split to exact-pinned mcp-types with snake_case attrs (wire camelCase via by_alias); deps pydantic>=2.12 anyio>=4.9 sse-starlette>=3.0 httpx2 opentelemetry-api; ping removed, no back-channel on 2026 connections, low-level Server auto-wrapping and jsonschema validation removed, exceptions sanitized to -32603 (only ToolError message reaches model); dual-era serving from one app, 2025-era sessions keep Mcp-Session-Id, 2026 uses per-request _meta + server/discover; v1 maintenance pin mcp>=1.28,<2.
